title: Devotees throng ISKCON Jagannath temple in Vijayawada for Nava Yauvana darshan
description: The first public darshan of Lord Jagannath, Lord Balabhadra and Goddess Subhadra after the 15-day Anavasara period drew devotees to the Krishnalanka temple; the chariot procession sets off from Sitara Grounds at 2 p.m. on July 16
